test_at_time_filter_by_time: test DataFrame.at_time filters rows by a specific time of day from a DatetimeIndex
test_at_time_with_string_format: test DataFrame.at_time accepts string time formats like '9:30' and '1:00AM'
test_at_time_with_timezone: test DataFrame.at_time with timezone-aware DatetimeIndex and timezone-naive time argument
test_at_time_axis_filtering: test DataFrame.at_time with axis parameter to filter columns by time instead of rows
test_at_time_ambiguous_format_warning: test DataFrame.at_time raises Pandas4Warning for datetime strings that cannot be parsed as time
